question: On a frozen population of credential-free public sites that mint server-side action-gating values (session cookies, CSRF tokens, one-time/nonce tokens) which vary across independent fresh sessions with disjoint cookie jars: what is the PREVALENCE, per site and pooled with site-clustered intervals, of minted-value classes that are PREDICTABLE from observable context (a non-identity transform of the previous value, issue order, the same-session session-cookie identity, or an embedded counter/timestamp/structure) BEYOND a frozen irreducibility null calibrated before freeze with demonstrated power, and SEPARABLE from a memory baseline that merely repeats the last observed value? READ: is the value-level observable a persistence surface (a freshness/repair engine can anticipate or cheaply re-derive the next valid value) or is server-minted action-gating state irreducibly observation-bound (the architecture must persist procedures/paths and re-observe values fresh)?
hypothesis: H1: among admitted action-gating fields, the pooled prevalence of fields classified PREDICTABLE beyond B_MEMORY_REPEAT and beyond B_IRREDUCIBILITY_NULL is at least P_HI = 0.25, and the site-clustered 95% CI lower bound exceeds P_FLOOR = 0.10. H0 (the shallow/null expectation): pooled prevalence is at or below P_FLOOR = 0.10, consistent with cryptographic/server-minted action-gating values being observation-bound on this substrate class. The design is explicitly two-sided and treats H0 as a first-class product-relevant outcome, not a failure.
falsifier: BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE SATISFIABLE AND FROZEN. Let PV = PREDICTABLE_PREVALENCE_POOLED, and let the site-clustered bootstrap 95% interval be [LO, HI]. (S1) H1 is SUPPORTED if PV >= P_HI = 0.25 AND LO > P_FLOOR = 0.10. (S0) H0 is SUPPORTED (this SUPPORTS FALSIFYING H1) if PV <= P_FLOOR = 0.10 AND HI < P_HI = 0.25. (SX) otherwise the result is MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE. Any of the frozen measurement-invalid conditions fires MEASUREMENT_INVALID, which takes PRECEDENCE over S1, S0 and SX and is never reported as FALSIFIES. A negative is valid and expected to be informative: it establishes that, on this substrate class and window, value-level persistence has no measurable surface and the architecture must persist procedures/paths and re-observe.

B_MEMORY_REPEAT.description: Mandated memory baseline. Over the field's observation series ordered by (session_index, request_index), the held-out predictor predicts the current value as equal to the immediately preceding observed value of the same field. Accuracy = fraction of i>=2 with pred_i == v_i. This is the 'merely repeats the last observed value' baseline the Director mandate requires the treatment to beat.
B_MEMORY_REPEAT.expected_behavior: Near 0 for genuinely varying minted values; high only if values persist across observations. A field is not counted PREDICTABLE on the strength of B_MEMORY_REPEAT.

B_MARKOV1.description: Stronger memory baseline, reported for transparency (NOT used as a disqualifier). First-order successor table vidx -> vidx fitted on the first 70% of ordered observations, applied to the held-out last 30%; unseen predecessors fall back to the training mode. Captures A/B alternation and any repeat structure a plain last-value predictor misses.
B_MARKOV1.expected_behavior: Beats B_MEMORY_REPEAT when values alternate or recur. Because the mandate's predictability classes explicitly include a non-trivial transform of the previous value (counters, increments), a field where only B_MARKOV1 succeeds is still reported with its firing non-baseline rule and its class; B_MARKOV1 is recorded as a sensitivity check, not as a gate.

B_CONSTANT_MODE.description: Triviality control, registered in response to the parent packet's mechanism-free-constant finding. Predicts the training-set mode for every held-out observation. Provides the triviality reference point so that no prevalence or accuracy claim is expressed as an unanchored absolute.
B_CONSTANT_MODE.expected_behavior: Matches the treatment only when the field is constant (which admission already excludes).

B_IRREDUCIBILITY_NULL.description: Calibrated irreducibility null. Cryptographic pseudo-random values matched to each real field's length and observed alphabet, drawn from the frozen regime set {uuid4, hex32, hex64, b64_16, b64_32, b62_20, b62_43, dec16} with N=200 fields per regime and n_obs=12 values per field, epoch0=1760000000, RNG seed = 9000 + regime_index. The frozen armed rule set is re-applied; a rule is ARMED iff its null field-level false-positive rate <= ALPHA_RULE = 0.05. DESIGN calibration (literal, embedded): 1600 null fields -> 1 field fired on any rule -> aggregate null FP = 0.000625; per-rule max FP = 0.000625 (R_WALLCLOCK_B64); all 11 non-baseline rules ARMED. This null has demonstrated discriminating power because the same frozen rule family detects the planted positive-control classes at power 1.0 (see PC_PLANTED_CLASSES) while firing on 1/1600 null fields.
B_IRREDUCIBILITY_NULL.expected_behavior: Fires on essentially no fields. Aggregate null FP must remain <= 0.05 at EXECUTE re-verification or the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

positive_control.description: Eight planted, by-construction-predictable field classes, 200 independent trials each with RNG seed = 5000 + trial and n in {8,10,12} observations: P_INT_INCR (decimal integers +7), P_HEX_INCR (hex integers +3), P_PREFIX_COUNTER (random constant shell + integer middle +5 per step), P_DEC_TS (epoch seconds +30), P_HEX_TS (hex epoch seconds +30), P_B64_TS (base64 of 6-byte big-endian epoch seconds +30), P_SESSION_BIND (value equals a same-session cookie value), P_HASH_BIND (value = sha256 hex of a same-session cookie value). A class is DETECTED on a trial iff the frozen rule family fires its designated rule (or any armed non-baseline rule) on that field.
positive_control.power_requirement: Every planted class must be detected at power >= 0.8 on the frozen trials at EXECUTE re-verification; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
positive_control.construct_boundary: This positive control is authored by the instrument designer. Per the Director's agent prior on author-validated instruments, it certifies the code path and detector sensitivity, NOT the construct boundary on the real Web. The real-Web confirmatory measurement and the out-of-author live null NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID are the mitigations; the boundary is disclosed as a residual validity threat.

null_control.description: Two-component null. (1) NC_PLANTED_RANDOM: the 1600-field synthetic irreducibility battery of B_IRREDUCIBILITY_NULL (8 regimes x 200 fields, n_obs=12). (2) NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID: an out-of-author live random source, GET https://httpbin.org/uuid, collected across K=8 fresh sessions to form fields of >=12 UUID4 values each (batch until n_obs>=12); a live-null field is DETECTED iff any armed non-baseline rule fires.

literal_design_values.NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID_reachability_livene: verified at DESIGN: GET https://httpbin.org/uuid returned HTTP 200 with a uuid4 JSON body; deterministic uuid4 null battery fired 0/200 fields

null_control.pass_condition: NC_PLANTED_RANDOM aggregate FP <= 0.05 AND NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID fired-field fraction <= 0.05, both re-verified at EXECUTE; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: The rule family and the class-priority attribution are frozen here, before freeze, and are fixed functions of a field's own observed values plus same-session cookie values only. No rule reads the confirmatory prevalence, the field's site label, or any outcome. The reproducibility seed is master_seed = int(request_hash[:8],16) = int('92124686',16) = 2450671238 (request_hash 92124686699fdafc6d8a6e7c620506602a301d390e95edfb9d109238ae5fee12); field collection order and session scheduling use master_seed-derived offsets so no post hoc selection is possible.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: There is no train/test site split in the parent's failed sense. The unit is the field; the rule family is not fitted to real fields (its criteria are frozen predicates), so there is no train/test leakage. Bootstrap resampling is clustered at the registrable domain (eTLD+1 approximation: last two dot-labels, with explicit multi-label public-suffix handling for the frozen universe's co.uk/org.uk-like cases; none occur in the frozen list, documented). EXECUTE must publish the field-to-cluster map.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The candidate universe of 57 credential-free endpoints is frozen verbatim in this spec.json (candidate_universe). Each endpoint is fetched with K=8 independent fresh sessions, each with a DISJOINT in-memory cookie jar and no shared state, and each session issues J=3 GETs of the SAME document URL. No authentication, no JavaScript, no rendering, no write/non-GET requests, python stdlib HTTP only. Admission is computed on the fresh confirmatory collection, not on DESIGN pilot values.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Site-clustered nonparametric bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, resampling registrable domains with replacement; two-sided 95% percentile interval on PREDICTABLE_PREVALENCE_POOLED. Cluster count and distinct resample count are reported; if distinct resamples < 1000 the interval is flagged uninformative and the outcome is capped at MIXED even if S1/S0 point thresholds are crossed. Per-site prevalence reported for every site with >=1 admitted field.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: Per field, EXECUTE archives the raw minted values (as evidence, redacted to length+sha256 for values longer than 512 chars), the locator type and name, the HTTP status, the ordered session/request index, the wall-clock epoch, and the same-session cookie name/value pairs used by SESSION_BIND/HASH_BIND. Response bodies are not archived (only field values and a body sha256), documented as representation loss. No JavaScript/SPA/DOM-rendered token, no authenticated token, no WebSocket/GraphQL/edge/mobile token is observable by this instrument.
measurement_validity.rule_family_frozenness: The 11-rule armed set and its predicates are frozen in this spec.json and prereg.md; EXECUTE may not add, remove, retune or threshold-shop a rule after seeing real fields. The null and positive-control batteries are re-run at EXECUTE with the frozen seeds and must reproduce the DESIGN power/FP requirement, and the re-run results are reported SEPARATELY from the DESIGN-embedded literal values.
measurement_validity.freeze_control_plane_disclosure: KNOWN PROGRAM-LEVEL CONSTRAINT (verified at source in the parent packet): scripts/freeze_experiment.py hashes exactly request.json, spec.json and prereg.md and provides no mechanism for a fourth artifact. Therefore NO pre-freeze pilot/power/attainability artifact is referenced by path as a frozen artifact; every mandated pre-freeze value is written LITERALLY inside this spec.json and prereg.md, exactly as the Director mandate requires. EXECUTE must not treat the absence of a separately hashed pilot file as a failure, and must not create a post hoc 'frozen' artifact.
measurement_validity.design_time_activity_disclosure: DESIGN ran ONLY non-outcome-bearing feasibility/liveness work: (i) a synthetic null/positive-power battery (no real-field outcome), (ii) an admission census (does a field mint a value that VARIES across fresh sessions), and (iii) reachability probes. DESIGN did NOT compute PREDICTABLE_PREVALENCE or apply the rule family to real minted values. The admission census observed the SAME candidate universe that is frozen here; because the rule criteria are fixed a priori and predictability was never inspected, this is a substrate-attainability check, not an outcome. This is disclosed as a residual threat to the cleanest possible separation and is why EXECUTE must recompute admission on a fresh collection.

decision_rule.metric_definition: N_PREDICTABLE / N_INDICATOR_FIELDS, where N_INDICATOR_FIELDS = admitted action-gating fields with >= N_MIN_OBS = 4 observations and a computable indicator, and N_PREDICTABLE = those fields where (a) at least one ARMED non-baseline rule fires, and (b) the firing rule's detection fraction on the field exceeds B_MEMORY_REPEAT held-out accuracy by at least DELTA_MEM = 0.10. A field that is sequentially deterministic but also memory-repeat-explained (e.g. an identity-persistent value) does not count; admission already excludes constant fields.
branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if ANY measurement_invalid_condition holds (see decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions). status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE. This branch PRECEDES S0 and S1; an instrument or substrate failure must NEVER be encoded as FALSIFIES.
2. SUPPORTS (S1): PV >= 0.25 AND site-clustered CI lower bound > 0.10.
3. FALSIFIES (S0): PV <= 0.10 AND site-clustered CI upper bound < 0.25.
4. MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE (SX): otherwise, including any CI that straddles a threshold and any interval resting on <1000 distinct cluster resamples.
measurement_invalid_conditions: (a) fewer than M_MIN_FIELDS = 20 admitted indicator fields at EXECUTE;
(b) fewer than S_MIN_SITES = 8 distinct registrable domains among admitted fields;
(c) NC_PLANTED_RANDOM aggregate FP > 0.05 on the frozen 1600-field battery, or NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID fired-field fraction > 0.05;
(d) any of the eight PC_PLANTED_CLASSES detected at power < 0.8 on the frozen 200-trial battery;
(e) collection transport error rate > 0.30 of planned GETs, or any non-GET request issued, or any authenticated/credentialed request issued;
(f) more than 0.30 of admitted fields cannot be assigned a frozen locator type or an action-gating name class;
(g) the frozen 57-endpoint candidate universe in this spec.json is not used verbatim (any substitution, addition or deletion);
(h) the rule family applied at EXECUTE differs from the frozen predicate set, or a rule threshold is changed post hoc.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: A SUPPORTS outcome can move C-WEB-DYNAMICS at most to EXPERIMENTAL for this substrate class and window; it cannot VALIDATE the claim and cannot promote to Product on its own. A FALSIFIES outcome is bounded to the frozen credential-free action-gating substrate and window and does not close the claim or the Physics domain.

product_consequence_positive: If PV >= 0.25 with clustered CI lower > 0.10, then value-level persistence has a measurable surface on credential-free action-gating state: a freshness/repair engine can ANTICIPATE or CHEAPLY RE-DERIVE the next valid session/CSRF/nonce value from observable context (previous value transform, issue order, session-cookie binding, or embedded counter/timestamp). Product may then memoize or repair values instead of unconditionally re-observing, and C-WEB-DYNAMICS gains a bounded mechanical prior for exploration. Any such capability still requires a separate authorizing verdict before Product Core.
product_consequence_negative: If PV <= 0.10 with clustered CI upper < 0.25, then server-minted action-gating state is observation-bound on this substrate class and window: value-level memoization/replay is not a viable surface, and the architecture must PERSIST PROCEDURES AND PATHS and RE-OBSERVE values fresh. This is a decision-changing negative: it directly informs the persist-values-versus-procedures decision, bounds value-replay caching expectations, and directs Product to procedural persistence plus cheap re-observation economics. UNKNOWN remains a valid product answer where the interval is inconclusive.

estimated_cost.http_requests_breakdown: 57 endpoints x K=8 sessions x J=3 GETs = 1368; plus ~176 control/misc requests (httpbin uuid batching + reachability)

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. This is the first bounded PREVALENCE estimate, with site-clustered intervals, of predictability in server-minted action-gating values, replacing the retired response-signature density/divergence estimator line that Codex found rank/magnitude-non-identifiable. It carries a both-directions falsifier, an out-of-author live null, a frozen irreducibility null with demonstrated power, a mandated memory-repeat baseline, and an arithmetic attainability certificate grounded in a literal pre-freeze census (16/57 endpoints admitted, 33 varying action-gating fields, 14 registrable sites). A valid positive establishes a value-level persistence surface; a valid negative establishes irreducibility and directs the architecture to procedures/paths plus fresh re-observation.

observable_object.unit: admitted action-gating field = (endpoint site, document URL, locator type, locator name)

action_gating_name_classes.TOKEN: name matches /token/i (one-time/login tokens such as wpLoginToken, wpCreateaccountToken)
action_gating_name_classes.NONCE: meta name matches /nonce/i (reported as a separate stratum; e.g. csp-nonce)

rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_INT_INCR: all values parse as decimal integers and consecutive deltas are a single nonzero constant d.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_HEX_INCR: all values parse as base-16 integers and consecutive deltas are a single nonzero constant d.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_B62_INCR: all values parse as base-62 integers over digits+upper+lower and consecutive deltas are a single nonzero constant d.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_PREFIX_COUNTER: the longest common prefix P and suffix S leave a varying middle that parses as integers with a single nonzero constant delta, and the constant shell length >= max(4, 0.25*min_len).
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_ORDER_LINEAR: integer values fit v_i = a + b*i (b != 0) on the first half and reproduce the held-out second half exactly.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_SESSION_BIND: at least 0.75 of observations equal, start with, end with, or contain (len>=8) a same-session cookie value.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_HASH_BIND: at least 0.75 of observations equal the md5, sha1 or sha256 hex digest of a same-session cookie value.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_WALLCLOCK_DEC: a decimal substring of length >= 10 decodes to epoch within +/- 3600 s of the observation wall-clock, at second or millisecond scale.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_WALLCLOCK_HEX: a hex substring of length >= 8 decodes to epoch within +/- 3600 s at second or millisecond scale.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_WALLCLOCK_B64: a base64 substring window of 4 bytes (big or little endian) decodes to epoch within +/- 3600 s at second or millisecond scale.
rules_nonbaseline_armed.R_CONST_SUBSTRING: the longest common substring across all values has length >= max(6, 0.40*min_len) while values are not all identical.

baselines_not_counted.R_MARKOV1: first-order successor table, held-out on last 30%, mode fallback.

admission_criterion.collection: per endpoint: K=8 independent fresh sessions, each with a disjoint in-memory cookie jar, no shared cookies; each session performs J=3 GETs of the same document URL; User-Agent fixed; timeout 20 s; body read capped at 600000 bytes.
admission_criterion.field_admitted_iff: (1) locator/name belongs to the frozen action-gating taxonomy and is not in the excluded_name_pattern; (2) at least 2 distinct raw values are observed across all sessions/requests; (3) the field is present in at least 2 distinct sessions; (4) at least N_MIN_OBS=4 observations total.
admission_criterion.strata: ALL (SESSION, CSRF, TOKEN) pooled for the primary metric; NONCE reported as a separate stratum and excluded from the primary metric by default, with an optional ALL_PLUS_NONCE sensitivity reported separately.

candidate_universe.selection_basis: A curated credential-free universe spanning Rails/GitLab, Gitea, Discourse, MediaWiki, Django, Python/PyPI, forum stacks, and session-minting login/search endpoints. Frozen verbatim; EXECUTE may not substitute endpoints.

pilot_certificates.disclosure: All values below are DESIGN-phase, literal, non-outcome-bearing feasibility/liveness measurements, embedded here because the freeze control plane hashes only three files (see measurement_validity.freeze_control_plane_disclosure). They are NOT confirmatory outcomes and NOT evidence about C-WEB-DYNAMICS.

live_null_liveness.verdict: PASS (out-of-author live source reachable; deterministic uuid4 battery fires on 0/200)

admission_census.note: 1 of the 33 is a meta csp-nonce (NONCE stratum, excluded from primary metric by default); 32 are SESSION/CSRF/TOKEN.

attainability_certificate_arithmetic.monotonicity_argument: The confirmatory collection uses K=8 sessions and J=3 requests versus the census's K=3/J=1. The variation criterion (>=2 distinct values) and the presence criterion (>=2 sessions) are monotone in the number of observations, so admission at K=8/J=3 can only be equal to or greater than the census admission, absent server-side change. The N_MIN_OBS=4 gate is the only new constraint and is satisfied by construction at K=8/J=3.
attainability_certificate_arithmetic.branch: If, despite this certificate, EXECUTE admits < 20 fields or < 8 sites, the run selects MEASUREMENT_INVALID (conditions (a)/(b)) and NOT FALSIFIES.

scope_boundaries: Credential-free public HTTP GET only; no authentication, no JavaScript, no DOM rendering, no SPA/GraphQL/WebSocket/edge/mobile observable.
Action-gating values only (SESSION/CSRF/TOKEN; NONCE reported separately); analytics/consent/ad/bot-management identifiers excluded by a frozen name pattern.
One stdlib-HTTP client, one collection window, one frozen 57-endpoint universe; rates describe this pool and window, not the Web.
A FALSIFIES outcome closes only this substrate class and window; it does not close C-WEB-DYNAMICS or the Physics domain (AGENTS.md physics discipline).
A SUPPORTS outcome moves C-WEB-DYNAMICS at most to EXPERIMENTAL and authorizes no Product promotion.
